Black sticker covers the entire car; stickers must be removed to determine paint status, especially on roof and hood which show high readings and signs of unscrewing bolts. Crack and pit in the windshield. Front left outer door handle issues. Small break in upper bumper grille, lower grille needs welding/fixing. Non-original front right wheel liner rubbing the tire. Signs of replacing shocks and inner/outer tie rods. Non-original engine shield. Roof lining needs cleaning. Minor hits to the floor. Needs gearbox mounts and tensioner. Needs cooling expansion tank. Front left door seal issues. Cut in lower oxygen sensor wires. Signs of repair in the alternator pulley. Rust/corrosion in the inner front right and left pillars under the rubber. Fading and cuts in roof and hood stickers. Oil seepage from the engine plug.
